items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So I worked with Bobby for the two weeks.

ctx.x: joined Bobby, because I was hanging around the clubs, you know, just to pick up gigs or anything I could get. And Leonard Feather walks in and asks me would I care to work with Bobby Burnet, and I told him it didn't make no difference to me. So I worked with Bobby for the two weeks.

Then I heard Cootie was getting a band together -- Cootie Williams. So I go in touch with Cootie, because you know, I knew Cootie; Cootie was a friend of mine. And I knew I was going to be in on that band. You know, I went up there. So I got in touch with Cootie, and he told me, "Yeah, sure." So I told Cootie, I said, "Well, look, I don't want any solos."
